description: This PHP class 'ApiDate' defines a validation rule for date strings, ensuring they conform to a specified date format ('Y-m-d'). It extends an abstract rule class and uses a trait for date validation helpers. The class is part of the API validation rules for version 2 of the OrangeHRM Core plugin.

classes.name: ApiDate
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given input is a valid date string matching the specified format ('Y-m-d'). It uses traits for date validation and extends an abstract validation rule.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input is a scalar value and whether it matches the date format using the inherited 'isDateTime' method.
